Technical overview / deterministic by design

Source-specific capture.
Shared output contract.

Each intake adapter parses and rewrites its own source, then returns the same typed ExtractedContent shape to deterministic target generators. Structure and fidelity come before component extraction; no language model sits in the conversion path.

01

Three intake paths. One exchange contract. Three generators.

HTML, URL, and bundle inputs run through different adapters. They converge on ExtractedContent, then diverge into standalone, EJS, and TSX targets.

02

Choose the transformation, not a preset.

The browser tool exposes the outputs that apply to the current source. The analyzer remains a separate API capability and is not part of the conversion workflow.

01

Format HTML

/api/format

Normalize a supplied HTML string and return readable markup in a JSON response envelope.

02

Separate resources

/api/export · /api/scrape

Lift inline CSS and executable scripts, localize supported remote assets, rewrite references, and return a ZIP.

03

Generate TSX

/api/export-nodejs · /api/scrape-nodejs

Translate the existing DOM into TSX and assemble a runnable Express, Vite, and TypeScript project.

04

Generate EJS

/api/export-nodejs-ejs · /api/scrape-nodejs-ejs

Move selected subtrees into shared EJS partials and assemble a server-rendered Express project.

05

Bundle an archive

/api/bundle-zip

Choose the most likely index page, retain referenced local assets, and return the original, split, and EJS outputs together.

06

Analyze patterns

/api/analyze · API only

Report heuristic suggestions for repeated semantic UI patterns. Analysis is separate from deterministic TSX conversion.

03

Source-specific capture, shared contracts.

The adapters reuse helpers, not one retained DOM. Their capture breadth and failure behavior differ before they converge on the same output-facing data shape.

  1. 01

    Validate the source

    HTML actions require a non-empty html string. Scrapes require a public HTTP(S) url. Bundle requests require a multipart field named file with a .zip filename.

  2. 02

    Run the matching source adapter

    extractor.Extract handles supplied HTML, scraper.ScrapeURL orchestrates remote capture, and bundle.ProcessWithOptions establishes a confined local root. Each path parses independently; bundle processing reparses after local-asset rewriting.

  3. 03

    Capture with source-specific coverage

    Direct HTML fetches absolute stylesheet and script URLs. URL capture also follows images, fonts, media, srcset, URL-bearing data-src, and recursive CSS dependencies. Bundle mode follows referenced files only inside its source root.

  4. 04

    Return the exchange contract

    Rewritten HTML, inline and external CSS/JS slices, local binaries, and capture evidence become ExtractedContent. Ordering is preserved within each typed collection; there is no single globally ordered resource list.

  5. 05

    Apply the target rules

    Standalone keeps the rewritten document. EJS extracts qualifying partials while preserving normal script execution. TSX converts deterministic component boundaries, pre-renders a matching body, hydrates it, then replays executable scripts sequentially.

    HTML input 
    <label class="field" for="email">
  Email
</label>
    TSX output 
    <label className="field" htmlFor="email">
  Email
</label>
  6. 06

    Package runtime files and evidence

    Standalone archives carry the document and captured files. EJS and TSX archives carry their runnable servers and project trees. API exports include uncluster-capture.json; CLI split and bundle flows use split-manifest.json instead.

04

Structure is the contract.

Conversion preserves the supplied page before it tries to make the result more modular. Decomposition may relocate a subtree into a file; it may not invent or discard structure.

DOM fidelity

Nodes, attributes, text, order, nesting, and significant whitespace remain represented in the output.

React syntax

Attributes, controls, entities, inline styles, raw text, and void elements use deterministic translation rules.

Shared boundaries

TSX and EJS share root expansion, candidate filtering, and naming helpers; each target applies its own extraction rules.

No model dependency

The transformation path is repeatable offline code. The analyzer is heuristic and remains separate.

Design rule

The same input and target produce the same transformation. Structural fidelity takes priority over aggressive component decomposition.

05

Remote and archive inputs stay bounded.

URL scraping and ZIP intake cross trust boundaries. Each path limits what it can reach, follow, expand, and write.

Public HTTP(S) only

Remote fetches reject other schemes and non-public destinations at connection time.

Redirect revalidation

Every redirect target is checked again instead of inheriting trust from the first URL.

Bounded downloads

Remote response bodies are capped at 25 MiB before they enter the extraction pipeline.

Safe archive expansion

ZIP paths cannot escape the temporary root, and expanded content is capped at 512 MiB.

Contained asset resolution

Local discovery stays inside the source root and rewrites only files reached from the page.

Portable references

Localized HTML, CSS imports, URLs, and srcset candidates use relative output paths.

06

API reference.

JSON failures include an error message. Framework-level failures may omit the handler response's success field. Binary routes return a ZIP on success.

Routes registered by the browser application's Fiber server.
Method Path Request Success response
POST /api/format { html: string } { success, data } JSON
POST /api/analyze { html: string } { success, suggestions } JSON
POST /api/export { html: string } Separated-resource ZIP
POST /api/export-nodejs { html: string } Express + Vite + TSX ZIP
POST /api/export-nodejs-ejs { html: string } Express + EJS ZIP
POST /api/bundle-zip multipart file: ZIP Original + split + EJS bundle ZIP
POST /api/scrape { url: string } Localized page ZIP
POST /api/scrape-nodejs { url: string } Localized Express + Vite + TSX ZIP
POST /api/scrape-nodejs-ejs { url: string } Localized Express + EJS ZIP
GET /api/health — { status, service, revision } JSON
CLI paths

The primary cmd/uncluster command also supports format, analyze, split, TSX, EJS, and bundle modes. cmd/uncluster-split provides the extraction-only path.
